families.name: Strategy
families.intent: Select interchangeable behavior behind a stable contract.

detectors.description: Names indicate interchangeable strategy, policy, rule, or selector behavior.

families.name: Factory
families.intent: Centralize variant creation behind a named creation boundary.

detectors.description: Names indicate factory or builder-style creation behavior.

families.name: Adapter
families.intent: Translate an external or incompatible interface into a local contract.
qualitySignals: external details stay at the boundary
local code depends on local shapes

detectors.description: Names indicate adapter, mapper, translator, or gateway behavior.

families.name: Facade
families.intent: Expose a smaller public API over a more complex subsystem.
qualitySignals: public surface is smaller than internals

detectors.description: Names indicate facade, gateway, coordinator, or orchestrator behavior.

families.name: Decorator
families.intent: Wrap behavior with additional policy while preserving the underlying contract.
qualitySignals: callers still see the original contract

detectors.description: Names indicate decorator, wrapper, proxy, retry, cache, auth, or logging wrappers.

families.name: Chain of Responsibility
families.intent: Pass work through ordered handlers until one handles or forwards it.

detectors.description: Names indicate middleware, pipeline, handler chain, or next-step behavior.

families.name: Command
families.intent: Encapsulate an action as a discrete object or handler.

detectors.description: Names indicate command, action, job, task, or execute/run/handle entry points.

families.name: Observer / PubSub
families.intent: Notify subscribers or listeners when state or events change.
qualitySignals: publisher does not know concrete observers

detectors.description: Names indicate event, listener, publish/subscribe, emit, or notification behavior.

families.name: Repository
families.intent: Isolate persistence access behind a collection-like application boundary.
qualitySignals: domain/application code avoids raw database calls

detectors.description: Names indicate repository, store, DAO, persistence, or data access boundaries.

families.name: Dependency Injection
families.intent: Pass dependencies explicitly instead of constructing or looking them up inside consumers.
qualitySignals: construction lives at the composition root

detectors.description: Names indicate providers, containers, injected dependencies, or composition roots.

families.name: Service Layer
families.intent: Place application orchestration behind transport-neutral services.
qualitySignals: services depend on ports or local contracts

detectors.description: Names indicate application service or orchestration layer behavior.

families.name: DTO Mapper
families.intent: Translate external transport or persistence shapes into local application shapes.
qualitySignals: external shapes do not leak inward
validation has a stable input model

detectors.description: Names indicate DTOs, mappers, serializers, parsers, or normalizers.

families.name: Configuration Boundary
families.intent: Load and normalize configuration at a clear boundary.

detectors.description: Code reads environment or configuration values.

families.name: Logging / Observability Boundary
families.intent: Keep logging, metrics, tracing, and diagnostic policy visible and consistent.

detectors.description: Code emits logs, metrics, traces, spans, or diagnostic records.

families.name: Validation Boundary
families.intent: Validate inputs at application or transport boundaries before core logic runs.

detectors.description: Names indicate validation, schema, guard, parser, or assertion behavior.

families.name: Error Handling Policy
families.intent: Normalize errors into consistent application or boundary-level results.

detectors.description: Names indicate error classes, result wrappers, exception mapping, or failure policy.

families.name: Large Conditional Dispatch
families.intent: Find branching that may deserve Strategy, Factory, Command, or Chain extraction.
qualitySignals: new variants do not require editing many branches

detectors.description: Conditional dispatch keywords are present; inspect before treating this as a smell.

families.name: God Class
families.intent: Find broad responsibility containers that may concentrate unrelated behavior, state, or dependencies.
qualitySignals: class or module owns unrelated responsibilities
name is broad rather than domain-specific

detectors.description: Names indicate broad responsibility containers; inspect size, cohesion, dependencies, and public surface before treating this as a smell.

families.name: Direct External API Leak
families.intent: Find external SDK or HTTP calls that may belong behind Adapter or Facade boundaries.
qualitySignals: external calls stay in integration modules

detectors.description: Direct HTTP or SDK-like calls are present; inspect boundary ownership.

families.name: Direct Database Leak
families.intent: Find direct database calls that may belong behind Repository or data-access boundaries.
qualitySignals: raw queries stay in persistence modules

detectors.description: Direct database or query calls are present; inspect data-boundary ownership.

families.name: Scattered Config Access
families.intent: Find direct config/env reads that may indicate configuration is not centralized.

detectors.description: Direct environment/config reads are present; inspect whether this module owns configuration.
